acceptanceCriteria: Both install-guide links resolve to the displayed first-run example and abridged receipt.
Guide examples work for the active candidate/version and never imply an older prerelease is current.
README heading count matches its table and each server row states whether it is in the qualified bundle, source-only, or unqualified.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, DOC-01. Source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a.

The install guide sends readers to #try-it-on-this-repository twice, but the README renamed that section to #sixty-seconds-on-this-repository. Both links land without the promised abridged receipt. The separately observed obsolete 0.5.0a3 prescription is covered by REL-04.

Source: docs/INSTALL.md:3; docs/INSTALL.md:92; README.md:55; docs/INSTALL.md:3; docs/INSTALL.md:37; docs/INSTALL.md:55; docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md:22; README.md:317; docs/INSTALL.md:128; docs/INSTALL.md:168

Observed checks: "README has ## Sixty seconds on this repository and no Try it on this repository heading; pinned first-run impact command succeeded. Version drift overlaps REL-04 and is excluded here."

Owning contract: "First-use documentation route; docs/PRODUCT.md:347-355."

Correction: Update the two anchors to the current README heading; make the guide’s first-use link part of the documentation link check.

REL-04: docs/INSTALL.md opens with 0.5.0a3 and hard-codes that version in extraction, expected output and candidate assembly, while the current published release notes identify 0.8.1. An operator following the main install guide can select an obsolete release or fail when the named candidate is unavailable. Correction: Use current version-independent placeholders and a link to the latest release inventory; keep the exact-version verification steps.

DOC-04: The agent-facing section announces three servers and immediately lists corvint-mcp, corvint-docs-mcp, corvint-corpus-mcp, and corvint-test-validity-mcp. INSTALL's optional bundle lists only three, without clarifying that corpus is separately experimental; a reader cannot tell which list is distributable. Correction: Correct the count and distinguish source-only experimental corpus server from the optional bundle inventory.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; original reports and evidence: .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Focused checks plus independent review are required for repair; any native release qualification needs the selected candidate and owner-dispatched run. No qualification or promotion is implied by this ticket.
title: Refresh installation version, first-run links and MCP bundle inventory
